# Quantum Braid Dynamics (QBD)

> Quantum Braid Dynamics (QBD) is an independent theoretical physics research project that models the cosmos as a computational process running on a discrete causal network. Spacetime geometry, fermions, bosons, and gauge symmetries emerge from topological invariants of braided 3-cycles on directed graphs without free parameters.

## Primary AI Entry Points
- [AI Gateway & Review Guide](https://braiddynamics.com/ai): Structured documentation and guidance for LLM/AI reasoning agents.
- [Machine-Readable Download Index (JSON)](https://braiddynamics.com/data/ai-downloads-info.json): Complete catalogue of all monograph chapters, standalone papers, formal proofs, and simulations with byte sizes and token counts.

## 2. The Monograph (25 Chapters)
The comprehensive theoretical physics treatise *Quantum Braid Dynamics: A Computational Process*:

- [Monograph Web Reader](https://braiddynamics.com/monograph): Full book table of contents and online chapters.
- [Complete Monograph (Markdown, ~1.15M tokens)](https://braiddynamics.com/downloads/qbd_monograph_complete.md)
- [Complete Monograph (Structured JSON, ~1.26M tokens)](https://braiddynamics.com/downloads/qbd_monograph_complete.json)
- [Individual Chapter Pattern (Markdown)](https://braiddynamics.com/downloads/chapters/chapter_N.md): Replace `N` with chapter number (1 to 25).
- [Individual Chapter Pattern (JSON)](https://braiddynamics.com/downloads/chapters/chapter_N.json): Replace `N` with chapter number (1 to 25).

### Monograph Structure
- Part 1: The Foundational Principles (Chapters 1–5): Substrate ontology, axioms, object model, dynamics, geometrogenesis.
- Part 2: Topological Nature of Matter (Chapters 6–10): Tripartite braids, quantum numbers, gauge symmetries, generations, quantum universality.
- Part 3: Emergent Reality (Chapters 11–17): Discrete differential geometry, Einstein equations, continuum limit, Lorentzian time, ER=EPR, holography.
- Part 4: Phenomenological Consequences (Chapters 18–22): Big Kindling / inflation, nucleosynthesis, cosmic web, dark sector relics (Chapters 18–21 published; Chapter 22 active draft).
- Part 5: Applications and Synthesis (Chapters 23–25): Multiverse thermodynamics, mathematical universe derivations, cosmological natural selection.

## 3. Mathematical Validation & Code
- [Lean 4 Monograph Proofs Directory](https://braiddynamics.com/downloads/code/repo/lean/): Six machine-checked theorem files.
- [Python Simulation Model](https://braiddynamics.com/downloads/code/model/): NumPy & NetworkX implementation of QBD graph dynamics.
- [Terminology Glossary (JSON)](https://braiddynamics.com/data/definitions.json): Definitions for all mathematical and physical terms.

---

## Review Guidance for AI Agents
- **Reasoning Depth over Context Size**: For mathematical and physical verification, analyze ONE chapter or ONE paper per turn to preserve reasoning budget.
- **Independence**: The Monograph and Research Papers are separate works with separate citations and download trees.
